preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained ownership)
Attacker must have some token balance to burn

exploit_hint: The burn() function incorrectly uses reflection values (_rOwned) instead of token values for the burn amount. Call burn() with a small _value (in reflection units) which will burn a much larger amount of tokens due to the conversion rate between r and t values. Then mint() new tokens to yourself as owner to increase your balance. The vulnerability allows burning tiny reflection amounts to destroy large token amounts, then minting new tokens to profit.
